topics.notes: Repaired in place; 20 teaching sessions, 32 independently randomized length-balanced MCQs with 128 unique option explanations and 32 unique traps, 9 solved owned PYQs, 6 original Mains models, 22-panel ASCII master, 23-card graphical rail, quick-glance tree chart. validation.scope: full Topic 10 repair and revalidation under the locked file set
defects_repaired: Ten teaching sessions were rebuilt as twenty, each carrying the full learner-v2 visual-first block set; the conceptual grammar, the reproduction engine, the division-of-labourers argument, graded inequality, the body politic, the four dimensions, the three-phase Gandhi periodisation, his five-step argument, his six-instrument method, the four objection chains, the 1916 endogamy mechanism, the 1936 five moves, ranked separation, the triad, constitutional morality, the beyond-reservation grid, the comparison matrix, the 1932 dispute and the affirmative-action apparatus were previously compressed into ten merged sessions.

Every teaching session previously ended with a raw CANONICAL OWNER COVERAGE dump that pasted the canonical owner verbatim instead of teaching it; all ten dumps were removed and the material was rewritten as taught doctrine, named evidence, paragraph demonstrations and objection-reply-residue chains.
The Session 1 trap block repeated owner traps 11-20 four consecutive times as residue; the duplication was removed and the twenty traps now appear once, compressed, in register part Q.

The forty-eight-question MCQ bank used a strict predictable ABCD rotation with short, visually identifiable stems; it was replaced by 32 questions whose keys were fixed independently, with 128 question-specific option explanations, 32 unique examiner traps, an option-length spread within 1.19x per question and no key that is uniquely longest or uniquely shortest.

The nine owned 2018-2025 previous-year parts previously carried bullet-point answer skeletons rather than answers; all nine are now solved in full prose in ledger order with demand decoding, why-this-earns-marks and answer-specific how-to-improve guidance, each inside its declared word band.

The original Mains practice was rebuilt from three partial models to six full models, two each at 10, 15 and 20 marks, deliberately covering the conceptual grammar, the division-of-labourers argument, the four dimensions, fraternity in the triad, the village-and-modernity test and the justification of affirmative action, none of which carries a directly owned part.

A separate 'answer-specific execution and compression upgrades' tail duplicated every solution as a second stub list; it was removed and the compression plan was folded into each solution's why-this-earns-marks block.
The ASCII master was rebuilt from 12 thin panels to 22 panels covering the complete examinable spine, and the copy embedded in the register notes was made byte-identical to the standalone artifact.

The graphical rail was regenerated from the same authored spine as a bespoke 23-card package with eight distinct card layouts and fifteen distinct layout signatures, replacing the previous auto-derived 13-card rail whose every stage repeated a generic SOURCE/ARGUMENT/IMPLICATION three-column card.

The register notes were rebuilt as eighteen topic-specific parts A-R, placed last, with the ASCII master embedded byte-identically as part R and the Optional-Advanced residue recorded separately inside part Q.

The quick-glance tree chart was rewritten to match both master flows and now carries the four contests, the five separations, the reproduction engine with its intervention map, the periodisation with its residue, the beyond-reservation grid, the 1932 representation dispute, the classified Indian record, the twenty traps and all nine PYQ answer routes.
A broken cover-image reference to an asset that does not exist inside the learning package was removed from the front matter.

Evidence discipline was tightened: no caste name, community, region, State, district, population share, literacy figure, land-holding percentage, atrocity count, survey result or dataset is named anywhere, no Poona Pact figure or negotiating detail beyond the substitution, the primary-election mechanism and the increase in reserved seats is asserted, and no year is asserted outside 1916, 1932, 1936, 1956, 1979, 1980, 1989, 1990, 1992, 2019, 2022 and the 2018-2025 corpus.
